headline: A London strategist warns the AI trade could end in the worst market crash since the financial crisis.
score_reason: Pool 5 kept; forecast read in full, headline close to the article.
importance_line: The bear case on AI spending and debt affects investors and savers, but it is the most bearish of eight tracked forecasts and its author says it may be premature.
summary: Bloomberg reports that Joachim Klement, head of market strategy at Panmure Liberum, a London investment bank, says the AI bubble will either burst in 2027 or 2028, which could trigger the most severe market crash since the global financial crisis. He is the most bearish of eight strategists Bloomberg tracks, he acknowledges his call may be premature, and he advises investors to make contingency plans rather than sell now.
notes: Read on the Yahoo Finance UK copy of the Bloomberg text (Bloomberg blocked). Interview date not stated; NEW.
